# duplocloud_k8s_reference_grant (Resource)

`duplocloud_k8s_reference_grant` manages a Kubernetes ReferenceGrant (gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1) in a Duplo tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "duplocloud_tenant" "myapp" {
  account_name = "myapp"
  plan_id      = "default"
}

// Allow HTTPRoutes in the "frontend" namespace to reference Services in this
// tenant's namespace.
resource "duplocloud_k8s_reference_grant" "grant" {
  tenant_id = duplocloud_tenant.myapp.tenant_id
  name      = "allow-frontend-routes"

  from {
    group     = "gateway.networking.k8s.io"
    kind      = "HTTPRoute"
    namespace = "frontend"
  }

  to {
    kind = "Service"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (Block List, Min: 1) The namespaces and resource kinds that are permitted to make cross-namespace references. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--from))
- `name` (String) The name of the ReferenceGrant.
- `tenant_id` (String) The GUID of the tenant that the ReferenceGrant will be created in.
- `to` (Block List, Min: 1) The resource kinds in the ReferenceGrant's namespace that may be referenced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--to))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `from`

Required:

- `kind` (String) The kind of the referencing resource (e.g. `HTTPRoute`, `Gateway`).
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the referencing resource that is allowed to make cross-namespace references.

Optional:

- `group` (String) The API group of the referencing resource. Use `gateway.networking.k8s.io` for HTTPRoute and Gateway.


<a id="nestedblock--to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `to`

Required:

- `kind` (String) The kind of the target resource (e.g. `Service`, `Secret`).

Optional:

- `group` (String) The API group of the target resource. Empty string for core Kubernetes resources (Services, Secrets).
- `name` (String) Optional name of a specific target resource. Omit to allow any resource of this kind.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Example: Importing an existing kubernetes ReferenceGrant
#  - *TENANT_ID* is the tenant GUID
#  - *NAME* is the ReferenceGrant name
#
terraform import duplocloud_k8s_reference_grant.mygrant v3/subscriptions/*TENANT_ID*/k8s/referencegrant/*NAME*
```
